newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Cars banned from Prague centre because of bad smog.
newsitem.headline: Cars banned from Prague centre because of bad smog.

text.p: Police closed the centre of the Czech capital Prague to all but vital traffic on Wednesday after city authorities declared a pollution emergency because of smog.
Police in radio broadcasts urged commuters to use public transport and told drivers locked in hour-long traffic jams on the edge of the city to switch off their engines.
Only delivery trucks, inner-city residents, emergency vehicles and officially sanctioned cars were allowed to drive into central districts.
Some drivers became embroiled in angry exchanges with policemen at roadblocks evaluating the importance of drivers' trips, the Czech agency CTK said.
It said the high smog level was due to pollution trapped in the air by the cold weather -- a common winter occurrence for Prague.
The city centre would stay closed until at least midnight, CTK added.
